description: This Java source file defines the DittoLogger interface, which extends SLF4J Logger with additional functionality for managing correlation IDs using MDC in a thread-safe way. It provides methods to set, derive, and discard correlation IDs globally or per log operation, supporting flexible tracing across logs in a Ditto-based system.

classes.name: DittoLogger
classes.description: An interface extending SLF4J Logger with additional MDC-based correlation ID management functionalities.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the subsequent log operation, returning the DittoLogger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withCorrelationId(WithDittoHeaders)
methods.description: Derives and sets the correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: withCorrelationId(DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Derives and sets the correlation ID from DittoHeaders for the next log operation.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for all subsequent log operations until explicitly discarded, returning an AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger for scope management.

methods.name: setCorrelationId(WithDittoHeaders)
methods.description: Sets a global correlation ID derived from WithDittoHeaders until manually discarded.

methods.name: setCorrelationId(DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Sets a global correlation ID derived from DittoHeaders until manually discarded.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the currently set correlation ID from the MDC.
